claims.statement: The definitive CBAM regime applies from 1 January 2026; importers above a single 50-tonne mass threshold must seek authorized-declarant status, declare embedded emissions and surrender corresponding certificates.
Supplier evidence quality and repeated data collection will be painful enough for threshold-crossing mid-market importers to outsource QA.
The number of accessible Polish importers above threshold and their service budget are not established by the regulatory source.

contrary_evidence: The 50-tonne threshold removes many small importers from the obligation.
The Commission provides official guidance, registry tools, default values and templates, and customs brokers may bundle assistance.
Incorrect classification or emissions calculations can create material compliance exposure beyond a software founder's competence.

economics.acquisition_route: Partner with customs brokers, freight forwarders and trade associations that can identify threshold-crossing importers at the paid event, avoiding mass consumer marketing.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned library of supplier identities, plant-method mappings and recurring validation exceptions can make repeat onboarding cheaper. Cross-customer reuse may be restricted and is not assumed to create a moat.
fingerprint.customer: Polish and CEE importers just above the CBAM mass threshold in iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity or hydrogen, especially firms without an internal carbon-accounting team.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Partner with customs brokers, freight forwarders and trade associations that can identify threshold-crossing importers at the paid event, avoiding mass consumer marketing.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Ingest customs lines and Commission supplier templates, identify in-scope goods, chase missing fields through structured multilingual forms, run consistency checks against methods and defaults, and maintain a versioned evidence trail. Begin as a productized managed service before building self-service software.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The importer pays per supplier onboarding or per quarterly data-quality pack, then an annual fee for declaration-ready evidence. A customs broker can resell the service; regulatory liability stays contractually with the declarant and qualified advisers.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A new supplier or shipment enters scope and the importer must obtain, validate and preserve embedded-emissions evidence before authorization, declaration and certificate obligations become costly or urgent.

founder_fit: Combines quantitative data validation with finance and regulation
Supplier-document workflows can be heavily automated and asynchronous
A single paid supplier pilot is possible without significant capital
Channel partners can carry relationship-heavy acquisition
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: CBAM supplier-data QA desk for mid-market importers
uncertainties: Polish importer counts and shipment frequency by covered sector above 50 tonnes
Share of suppliers able to provide usable plant-level data
Broker partnership economics and incumbent competition
Required insurance, expert sign-off and liability limits
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: Interview five customs brokers and ten threshold-crossing importers in two covered sectors, then complete one fixed-fee historical supplier-data QA pack using the customer's own shipment and evidence files. Continue only if the buyer pays for the next live supplier or quarter and a qualified adviser accepts the responsibility split.
